app.name: Mridanga Seva
app.tagline: Class records, lessons and attendance in one place
app.slowStart: This is taking long. Check your internet connection, then try again.

offlineQueue.doorWaiting_one: {{count}} check-in is waiting for the signal
offlineQueue.doorWaiting_other: {{count}} check-ins are waiting for the signal
offlineQueue.doorBody: They are kept on this phone and sent by themselves when the internet is back. The time saved is when they arrive. Keep the app open or come back to it; do not sign out before they are sent.
offlineQueue.doorQueuedTitle: No connection: saved on this phone
offlineQueue.doorQueuedBody: This check-in is sent when the signal is back. A scanned code is sent as a check-in; nothing changes if the student is already in.
offlineQueue.practiceWaiting_one: {{count}} practice entry is waiting for the signal
offlineQueue.practiceWaiting_other: {{count}} practice entries are waiting for the signal
offlineQueue.practiceBody: They are kept on this phone and sent by themselves when the internet is back. Do not sign out before they are sent.
offlineQueue.practiceQueued: No connection: {{time}} kept on this phone. It is saved to your log when the signal is back.
offlineQueue.notSavedTitle: Some saves from this phone did not go through
offlineQueue.refused_one: {{count}} was refused by the server (for example a day already full, or a student whose record is closed).
offlineQueue.refused_other: {{count}} were refused by the server (for example a day already full, or a student whose record is closed).
offlineQueue.tooOld_one: {{count}} waited too long to be saved (a check-in of an earlier day, or practice older than 14 days). Enter it by hand if it matters.
offlineQueue.tooOld_other: {{count}} waited too long to be saved (check-ins of an earlier day, or practice older than 14 days). Enter them by hand if they matter.

webArea.loadFailed: This page could not be opened: it needs the internet the first time it opens on this device. Check your connection and try again.

common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

serverErrors.frozen: This can no longer be changed.
serverErrors.locked: This detail cannot be changed here.
serverErrors.notFound: It is not there any more. Refresh and try again.
serverErrors.openLoan: This student still has an instrument on loan. Take it back first.
serverErrors.rollNoFrozen: The roll number can no longer be changed.
serverErrors.needsCallLog: Log a call first, then change the status.
serverErrors.memberNotAllowed: This person cannot be added to the group.
serverErrors.notYourself: You cannot do this to your own login.
serverErrors.guruOnly: Only the Guru can do this.
serverErrors.staffOnly: Only coordinators and the Guru can do this.
serverErrors.centreInUse: This centre is in use and cannot be deleted. Switch it off instead.
serverErrors.visitFuture: A visit cannot be in the future.
serverErrors.settingRequired: This setting cannot be left empty.
serverErrors.tooManyRows: Too many rows at once. Split the sheet and try again.
serverErrors.mfaRequired: This needs your sign-in code: the Guru asks for one before private details show. Set it up in My profile → Sign-in code.

common.studentWithdrawn: Consent for this student was withdrawn. Nothing new can be recorded for them; ask the Guru.
common.networkError: Could not reach the server, or it did not answer. Check your internet connection and try again; if it keeps happening, tell a coordinator.
common.refreshFailed: Could not refresh. Showing what was loaded at {{time}}.
common.fixFieldsAbove: Some fields need a fix ({{count}}). Each has its message under it, above.
common.linkOpensInBrowser: The link opens in your web browser. When you are done there, come back to this app and sign in.
common.ownRecord: This is your own student record: a colleague records it (check-in, ticks, level, calls). Ask another coordinator.
common.ownMentor: A student is never their own mentor. Choose another coordinator of the same gender.
common.staffLoginLinked: This record is a staff member's own. Take the app login off it first (Coordinators), then withdraw or erase.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the email and password you signed up with.
signIn.linkFailedTitle: This email link did not work
signIn.linkBody: Each email link works only once, and only for a while. Ask for a new link here. For a new confirmation email, first type your email in the sign-in form below.
signIn.resent: If {{email}} has an account waiting to be confirmed, a new link is on its way. Check the inbox and the spam folder.
signIn.endedBody: Your login ended (it ran out, or the password was changed on another device). Please sign in again. A student registration or announcement you were writing is kept: open it again after signing in.

signUp.title: New student registration
signUp.subtitle: Sign up here before you come; the desk then accepts your sign-up.
signUp.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
signUp.checkEmail: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your account, then sign in.
signUp.under18: Under 18? Ask at the class desk.
signUp.fullNameId: Full name as on your Aadhaar or other government ID
signUp.fullNameIdHint: We keep only the name, never the ID number or a copy of the ID.
signUp.dobHint: To know whether a parent's consent is needed.
signUp.dobRequired: Choose the day, month and year.
signUp.dobInvalid: This date does not exist or is in the future.
signUp.genderHint: Each student has a coordinator of the same gender.
signUp.chooseCentre: Choose the country and city of your centre.
signUp.fixFields: Please correct the fields that show a message under them.
signUp.nextStep: After you sign in, the app asks a few optional questions about you. Then come to the class desk: a coordinator checks your name against your ID and registers you.
signUp.choicesNeeded: Your centre is needed before the account can be made. Check the internet connection, tap Try again, then Create account.
signUp.noticeRead: I have read the privacy notice.
signUp.noticeRequired: Read the privacy notice (link above), then tick this box.
signUp.laterNote: Your mobile number, gender, Diksha name and the instruments you want to learn come later, in About you, after you sign in.
signUp.laterNoteMinor: Nothing more is asked now: the rest is recorded at the class desk after your parent has given consent.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email. We will send you a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link is on its way. It can take a few minutes.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.signedInAs: Setting a new password for {{email}}. Not your email? Choose Cancel.
resetPassword.saveAndSignOut: Save and sign out of this browser
resetPassword.browserNote: On a shared or borrowed computer, or if you use the Android app, choose "Save and sign out of this browser". Then sign in to the app with the new password.

validation.passwordsDontMatch: The two passwords are not the same.
validation.nameDigits: A name has letters only, no numbers.
validation.nameSymbols: Use letters only. A space, dot (.), apostrophe (') or hyphen (-) may go between them.

authErrors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first. Open the link we sent you.
authErrors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
authErrors.weakPassword: This password is too easy to guess. Choose a stronger one.
authErrors.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
authErrors.emailNotSent: The email could not be sent just now. Please try again in a few minutes, or later in the day. You can also come to the class: the desk registers you there.
authErrors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the old one.
authErrors.sessionEnded: Your sign-in has ended. Please sign in again.
authErrors.linkExpired: This email link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
authErrors.signupClosed: New accounts cannot be made just now. Please ask a coordinator.
authErrors.accountOff: This account is switched off. Please ask a coordinator.
authErrors.signUpRefused: The login could not be made. If your name is the same as the Guru's or a coordinator's, add your surname or an initial and try again. Otherwise ask at the class desk.

pending.title: Waiting for access
pending.body: Your account is ready. Come to the class desk with an ID: a coordinator checks your name and registers you.
pending.studentHint: When the coordinator says you are registered, tap Check again.
pending.stepDesk: Come to the class desk with an ID
pending.stepDeskHint: A coordinator checks your name and registers you.
pending.stepQr: Your QR card for the door
pending.stepQrHint: Your home opens here by itself once you are registered.
pending.kiosk: The door tablet screens come in a later version.
pending.inactiveBody: This account is not active. Please speak to the facilitator or a coordinator.
pending.igHint: Study the slokas with us: the sloka of the day, themes, your own notes. No class role needed.
pending.serverError: The server answered with an error. Tap Check again in a few minutes; if it keeps happening, sign out and tell a coordinator.
pending.missingProfile: Your account is not set up yet. Tap Check again in a minute; if it stays like this, sign out and sign in again.

waiting.title: While you wait
waiting.body: You can start practising now; the desk does not have to accept you first.
waiting.lessonsDetail: Lesson videos of the first level
waiting.lessonsIntro: The lesson videos of the first level. Watch one, then practise it with the taal player.
waiting.lessonsOffline: No internet: this is the list kept on this device. The videos play once you are online again.
waiting.lessonsEmptyBody: The Guru adds the lesson videos. Meanwhile the practice tools are ready for you.
waiting.closedBody: This opens once the desk has accepted you, or, under 18, once your parent has given consent.

home.title: Home
home.mantraLine1: Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Krishna Krishna Hare Hare
home.mantraLine2: Hare Rama Hare Rama Rama Rama Hare Hare
home.loadFailed: Could not load the numbers for this page.

staff.newJoinersHint: Newest first. Tap a name to open the profile. Someone with no visits yet may need a call.
staff.newJoinersEmpty_one: Nobody new joined in the last week.
staff.newJoinersEmpty_other: Nobody new joined in the last {{count}} weeks.

guru.byLevelHint: Students in class, not counting those who left.
guru.byStatusHint: Every student, including those who left.
guru.followUpsHint: Calls past their date, and students handed to you. Tap to open the follow-ups.

waiting.title: To do
waiting.nothing: Nothing is waiting. Thank you for your seva.

setup.title: App not set up
setup.missing: The server address or key is missing. Copy app/.env.example to app/.env, fill in both values, then restart.
setup.secretKey: This is the secret (service_role) key. Never put it in the app. Use the publishable (anon) key instead.

scanner.label: Camera for scanning a student's QR code
scanner.permissionNeeded: The app needs the camera to scan QR codes. Nothing is recorded or saved.
scanner.permissionBlocked: The camera cannot be used: it is switched off for this app, or there is none. Switch it on in the phone's settings, or search the name below.
scanner.noCamera: The camera could not start. Search the name below instead.

attendance.title: Check-in
attendance.loadFailedBody: Cannot reach the server. You can still scan or check in by name: the buttons may not know who is already here until the list loads.
attendance.scanIntro: Ask the student to open My QR in the app, or to show their printed QR card, and hold it in front of the camera.
attendance.searchHint: Type at least 2 letters of the name, or digits of the roll number.
attendance.noMatch: No student found. Check the spelling, or register the student.
attendance.searchFailed: Could not search. Check your internet connection.
attendance.unknownBody: This is not a student's QR code for this class, or it is an old card that was replaced. Search the name or roll number instead.

errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can mark attendance.
errors.notFound: This student is no longer in the records.
errors.alreadyMarked: Another phone marked this student at the same moment. Check the list and try again.

attendance.moreMatches: Showing the first {{number}}. Type more of the name to find the right student.
attendance.checkingBody: Wait for the answer before the next student.
attendance.waitForLast: Still checking the last scan. Wait for its answer, then scan again.

attendanceLocation.why: When you check a student in, the app checks your phone's location — only while the app is open, to confirm you are at the class. Outside the area the check-in is still saved, but flagged for the facilitator.
attendanceLocation.refusedNote: Location is not allowed for this app, so check-ins are saved but flagged. To allow it: phone Settings → Apps → Mridanga Seva → Location.

flag.outside: Outside the class area ({{distance}} m away) — flagged for the facilitator.
flag.refused: Location not allowed — flagged for the facilitator.
flag.no_fix: No location found in time — flagged for the facilitator.
flag.no_location: This browser gives no location — flagged for the facilitator.

attendanceLocation.flaggedHint: Check-ins where the phone was outside the area or gave no location. The visit still counts; look into ones that repeat.

hereNow.title: In class now
hereNow.empty: Nobody is checked in right now.
hereNow.sinceEarlierDay: Since {{date}} {{time}}: not checked out that day
hereNow.confirmTitle: Check out everyone in class now ({{number}})?
hereNow.confirmBody: Use this when the class closes. Each visit ends now; a visit left open from an earlier day ends at that day's closing time.

myQr.title: My QR card
myQr.howTo: Show this code to the coordinator when you arrive and again when you leave. They scan it to check you in and out.
myQr.keepPrivate: This code is only for you. Do not send a photo or screenshot of it to anyone.
myQr.savedCopy: No internet right now. This is the copy saved on your phone; it can still be scanned.
myQr.loadFailed: Could not load your QR card
myQr.noRecordBody: Your login is not connected to a student record. Please speak to a coordinator.
myQr.statusInBody: Hare Krishna! Your visit is recorded.
myQr.statusOut: Checked out. Today's visit began at {{time}}.

me.title: Me
me.intro: Your own student record: your QR card, progress, attendance and practice, as a student sees them. A colleague checks you in and ticks your syllabus.
me.noRecordBody: Your login is not linked to a student record of your own. The Guru links it on Coordinators.

register.title: Welcome desk
register.intro: Takes about two minutes. Only the name and date of birth are required.
register.dobHint: It decides whether a parent's consent is needed.
register.ageMinor: Age {{age}} — under 18, a parent's consent is needed
register.emailHint: The student's own email, if they are 18 or over and will use the app. Their login is connected to this record.
register.areaHint: Only the area, e.g. Koti. Not the full address.
register.guardianIntro: Needed because the student is under 18.
register.idCheckedHint: Look at the parent's ID to confirm who they are. Do not write down the number.
register.photoConsent: The parent agrees to a photo of the student on the class record.
register.writtenConsent: The parent has filled in and signed the paper consent form, and I have kept it with the class records.
register.linked: Their app login is now connected to this record.
register.signUpNotLinked: The app login of {{name}} was not connected to this record: a child's record is never connected by itself, and an adult's only when the email is the same. The sign-up stays in the waiting list. If this login should open this record in the app, the Guru links it: Coordinators, the person, "Or link to a student record". Do not register {{name}} again.
register.alreadySaved: This student had already been saved: the answer to the first Save did not arrive. Nothing new was stored; check the details on the student's record.
register.loadFailed: Could not load levels and coordinators.

errors.dobInvalid: Choose a real date of birth, not in the future.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9, or a number with + and the country code.
errors.pincodeInvalid: A pincode has 6 digits and does not start with 0.
errors.consentNeeded: The signed consent form is needed before a student under 18 can be registered.
errors.minorNeedsConsent: A student under 18 needs the parent's details, the ID check and the signed consent form.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can register students.
errors.fixFields: Please correct the fields that show a message under them.
errors.minorByServer: By the server's date this student is under 18. Fill in the parent's part below and save again.
errors.guardianEmailOnMinor: This is a parent's email. A child's record keeps the child's own email, or none: a login with a parent's email would be linked as the child.
errors.mentorInactive: That mentor is no longer active. Choose another mentor, or Automatic.
errors.nameInvalid: Check the name: letters only (any language), at least two. A space, dot, apostrophe or hyphen may go between them.
errors.genderUnknown: This gender is not in the form choices. Choose one of the options.
errors.consentRefused: The server did not accept the parent's consent for this student. Check the parent's details and save again; if it happens again, tell the Guru.

register.privacyNoticeHint: Show it to the parent before they sign the consent form.
register.fullNameHint: As on the Aadhaar or other government ID you see. Never write down the ID number.
register.waitingTitle_one: {{count}} person signed up and waits for the desk
register.waitingTitle_other: {{count}} people signed up and wait for the desk
register.waitingHint: Accept registers an adult with what they gave: check the name against their ID first. Fill the form to change something, or for anyone under 18 (they come with a parent).
register.filledBody: Check every field with the person; the name must match their ID.
register.mentorAuto: Automatic (a coordinator of the same gender)
register.moreHint: The same questions as About you in the app. The student can change them later.
register.detailsFailed: The student is saved, but the extra details were not. Open the student's page and add them there.
register.acceptCheckId: Check the name against the government ID.

duplicates.title_one: Possible duplicate: is this person already here?
duplicates.title_other: {{count}} possible duplicates: is this person already here?
duplicates.signUp: {{name}} · signed up {{date}} · {{centre}} · waiting in the list above
duplicates.sameNameAndBirth: same name and date of birth
duplicates.hintSave: If it is the same person, do not save again: open their record, or accept their sign-up in the list above.
duplicates.hintAccept: If it is the same person, do not accept: open their record instead. Accept only someone who is not on record.

register.acceptChange: Change something first: fill the form
register.acceptedLogin: Their app login is connected: they see their student home the next time they open the app.
register.acceptedExisting: A record with this email was already on file; the login is now connected to it.
register.acceptedRepeated: This sign-up had already been accepted; nothing new was stored.

acceptErrors.alreadyRegistered: This person already has a student record.
acceptErrors.notWaiting: This person no longer waits for the desk (the login is switched off or already has a role).
acceptErrors.emailNotConfirmed: The person has not confirmed their email yet. Ask them to open the link in the sign-up email.
acceptErrors.noDob: The sign-up has no date of birth. Use Fill the form.
acceptErrors.minor: Under 18: register at the desk with a parent. Use Fill the form.
acceptErrors.noName: The sign-up has no name. Use Fill the form.
acceptErrors.unavailable: Accept is not available on this server yet. Use Fill the form.
acceptErrors.noNotice: This sign-up has no privacy tick (made with an older app). Use Fill the form: show them the privacy notice there, tick the box and save.
acceptErrors.nameInvalid: The name in this sign-up does not follow the name rule. Use Fill the form and correct it against their ID.

register.otherSavedBody: This form had already saved {{other}} ({{rollNo}}) before its answer was lost. Check the details and tap Save again: {{name}} is then saved as a new student.
register.waitingLoadFailed: Could not load the people waiting for the desk
register.waitingStale: Could not refresh. This is the list from before; pull down or tap Refresh list to try again.
register.waitingSearchHint: Part of the name or email, or 3 or more digits of the phone.
register.waitingNoMatch: Nobody waiting matches. Check the spelling, or ask whether they opened the link in the sign-up email.
register.waitingNoNotice: No privacy tick at sign-up: use Fill the form.
register.emailHintMinor: Optional: the child's own email, never a parent's. A child's record is not linked to an app login: the child checks in with the printed QR card (Print QR cards).
register.adultNoticeFromSignUp: They ticked the privacy notice at sign-up; it is kept on the record.
register.adultNoticeShown: I showed them the privacy notice (kept on the record).

minorAccept.idRequired: Choose the kind of the parent's ID you saw.
minorAccept.notConsented: The parent has not given consent by email yet. Wait, or use Fill the form with the parent at the desk.
minorAccept.notMinor: This person is 18 or over: use Accept for adults (reload the list).
minorAccept.parentEmailTaken: The parent's email is already on a child's own record. Use Fill the form and check the details.
minorAccept.checkId: Check the parent's ID (for example Aadhaar): the name is {{name}} and the age is 18 or over. Only the kind of ID is kept.
minorAccept.rowConsented: Parent consented by email; parent's ID not yet seen

students.title: Students
students.loadFailed: Could not load the student list.
students.empty: No student matches. Change the search or the filters.

profile.title: Student
profile.notFound: This student is not in the records.
profile.guardianStaffOnly: Only coordinators and the facilitator can see this.
profile.consentMissing: No current consent from the parent is on record. Please tell the facilitator.
profile.noSyllabus: The syllabus for this level has not been added yet.
profile.withdrawnBody: Nothing new is recorded for this student (visits, calls, practice, loans). The record is erased 30 days after the withdrawal, unless the parent or student consents again before then; the Guru can erase it sooner.
profile.ownTitle: This is your own student record
profile.ownBody: A colleague checks you in and out, ticks your syllabus, logs calls and nominates you; the Guru decides your level. Your QR card and progress are under Me on your home.

syllabus.title: Mark progress
syllabus.intro: Tap the box when the student shows the item in class. Today's date and your name are saved with the tick.
syllabus.remarkHint: Optional, e.g. "needs a steadier tempo". Up to {{max}} characters.
syllabus.untickBody: Use this only if it was ticked by mistake. The date and remark go from the list; the class records keep a copy.
syllabus.alreadyTicked: Someone else ticked this a moment ago. Their tick is kept.
syllabus.alreadyUnticked: This was already unticked. Nothing changed.

errors.remarkTooLong: The remark is too long. Keep it under 500 characters.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can tick syllabus items.
errors.gone: This item or tick is no longer there. The list has been loaded again.
errors.retired: This item is no longer taught, so it cannot be ticked.

syllabus.allDone: Every item of {{level}} is ticked. Moving up a level is the facilitator's decision.

followUp.title: Follow-ups
followUp.intro: Students who have stopped coming. Tap a name to phone them and record the call.
followUp.loadFailed: Could not load the follow-up list.
followUp.empty: Nobody needs a call right now.
followUp.escalatedHelp: Several calls with no answer, or no call made before the student became Inactive.

callLog.title: Record a call
callLog.noPhone: No phone number on the record.

outcomeHelp.returning: They will come again. If they have not come by the day after the date, a new call is due.
outcomeHelp.paused: They are taking a break until the date (exams, travel, health). No reminders till then.
outcomeHelp.not_reachable: Nobody answered. A new try is due in a few days; after several tries the facilitator is told.
outcomeHelp.discontinued: They have stopped coming. Their status becomes Left. They keep their roll number, and their next visit makes them Active again.

callLog.commentHint: Required. A short note for whoever calls next.
callLog.confirmLeftBody: They leave the follow-up list. Their record, roll number and history are kept, and their next visit makes them Active again. Their login keeps working, and they still get class messages and notifications, until the Guru switches the login off.
callLog.confirmLeftYes: Yes, save and mark as Left

saved.returning: {{name}} is expected on {{date}}. If they do not come, a new call is due the day after.
saved.not_reachable: Saved as not reachable. A new try is on the follow-up list.

errors.dateInvalid: Enter the date as day-month-year, e.g. 15-10-2026.
errors.datePast: The date cannot be before today.
errors.commentRequired: Write what was said on the call.
errors.reasonUnknown: This reason is no longer in the list. Choose another.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can log calls.
errors.notFound: This student is not in the records.
errors.dateTooFar: Choose a date within the next 12 months.

callLog.dialFailed: This device cannot open a phone call. Dial {{phone}} on your phone.

compose.title: New announcement
compose.titleHint: Short, e.g. "No class on Friday". Up to {{max}} characters.

audienceHelp.all: Every student who uses the app. Coordinators and the facilitator see every announcement.
audienceHelp.level: Students at the level you choose.
audienceHelp.mentees: The students you are mentor for.
audienceHelp.staff: Only the facilitator and coordinators. Students do not see it.
audienceHelp.group: The members of the group you choose.

compose.pin: Pin it to the top of the list
compose.timeHint: 24-hour, the centre's time, e.g. 18:30 (6:30 pm also works)
compose.laterHelp: Students see it from then. Coordinators and the facilitator see it at once.
compose.noGroups: There are no groups yet, so "A group" is not offered. Make one first.

detail.title: Announcement
detail.notFound: This announcement is no longer there.
detail.nobodyAddressed: Nobody with the app is in this audience yet.
detail.scheduledNote: Not published yet, so nobody has seen it.
detail.noLoginNote_one: {{count}} student in this audience does not use the app. Tell them in class.
detail.noLoginNote_other: {{count}} students in this audience do not use the app. Tell them in class.
detail.deleteBody: It disappears for everyone, with its photos and PDFs and the list of who has seen it. The class records keep a copy of the text.

edit.title: Edit announcement
edit.publishedNote: It stays read for those who have seen it, and shows "Edited" with the time. The time it was published cannot change.
edit.scheduledNote: Not published yet: you can still change when students see it.

replies.title: Replies ({{number}})
replies.privateNote: Replies are private: only the author and the facilitator see them. Answer in person or by phone.
replies.whoReads: Only {{name}} and the facilitator see your reply.
replies.whoReadsNoName: Only the author and the facilitator see your reply.

errors.titleTooLong: The title is too long. Keep it to 120 characters.
errors.bodyTooLong: The message is too long. Keep it to 4000 characters.
errors.dateInvalid: Enter the date as day-month-year, e.g. 04-10-2026.
errors.timeInvalid: Enter the time as hours:minutes, e.g. 18:30.
errors.timePast: This time has already passed. Choose a later time, or publish now.
errors.notAllowed: Only coordinators and the facilitator can post announcements.
errors.cannotChange: Not changed: only the author or the facilitator can change it, or it was deleted.
errors.groupGone: This group no longer exists. Choose another.
errors.alreadyPublished: It was published meanwhile, so its time can no longer change. Nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.replyTooLong: The reply is too long. Keep it to 1000 characters.
errors.replyGone: This announcement is no longer there, or no longer for you.
errors.changedMeanwhile: Not saved: someone else changed this announcement while you were editing. Load the latest version and make your change again.
errors.maybeSaved: No answer from the server, so it is not known whether this was saved. Check the announcements list before you try again.
errors.dateTooFar: Choose a date at most 6 months ahead.
errors.groupInactive: This group is switched off. Switch it on in Groups, or choose another audience.

files.limits: Up to {{max}} files. Photos are made smaller before they are sent. A PDF can be up to 5 MB.
files.consentHint: Only add a photo that shows a student if their parent has given photo consent. Many students are under 18, and the law (DPDP) requires a parent's consent.
files.pdfHint: Readers see the PDF's file name and the details saved inside it, such as its author. If they name a person, rename or re-save the PDF before adding it.
files.full: {{max}} files added, the most an announcement can have.
files.uploading: Sending the files… this can take a moment on a slow connection.
files.tooMany: An announcement can have at most 3 files. Remove one first.
files.tooBig: This file is bigger than 5 MB. Choose a smaller one.
files.notPdf: Only PDF files can be added here. For photos, use "Add photos".
files.someLeftOut: Only the first ones were added: an announcement can have at most 3 files.

facts.title: Did you know?
facts.f1: Mṛdaṅga comes from the Sanskrit mṛt, clay, and aṅga, body: a drum with a body of clay.
facts.f2: In Bengal the mṛdaṅga is called the khol.
facts.f3: The mṛdaṅga has been the drum of saṅkīrtana since Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, in Bengal in the 15th century.
facts.f4: The small head, the dāyāṅ, gives the high ringing sounds; the wide head, the bāyāṅ, gives the deep bass.
facts.f5: The black centre of each head is the syāhī, a paste with rice and iron filings that gives the drum its tone.
facts.f6: Damp air makes the bass head sound deeper and dry air higher, so players sometimes wet it a little.
facts.f7: The fibreglass mṛdaṅga was first made in the 1970s, so the drum would not break on travels or in the rain.
facts.f8: A clay khol has the warmest sound but needs care: keep it from strong heat and cold, with covers on the heads.
facts.f9: Never stand a mṛdaṅga on its bass head; lay it on its side.
facts.f10: Bols are the drum's alphabet: tā, nā and tī on the small head; ka, gha and ga on the big one.
facts.f11: dhā is tā and ga played together, one stroke on each head.
facts.f12: The Bengali khol is not the South Indian mṛdaṅgam, which has a wooden body and its own bols and tālas.
facts.f13: Kartāls keep time with the mṛdaṅga in four beats: open, closed, closed, open.
facts.f14: A little practice every day, 15 to 30 minutes, does more than one long session a week.
facts.f15: The rings of a head, from the edge in: gajarā, kinār, maidān and the black syāhī.

welcome.level: Your level: {{level}}. See what you will learn in My progress.

minorSignUp.parentNameRequired: Enter your parent's or guardian's name.
minorSignUp.parentEmailHint: Their own email, not yours: the consent email goes here.
minorSignUp.parentEmailOwn: This is the email you sign in with. Enter your parent's or guardian's own email.
minorSignUp.parentPhoneRequired: Enter your parent's or guardian's mobile number.

minorSignUp.nextStep: After your parent consents, come to your first class with your parent's ID (for example Aadhaar), or with your parent. A coordinator checks it and registers you.
minorSignUp.stepParent: Your parent gives consent by email

minorSignUp.stepDeskHint: Bring your parent's ID, or your parent. A coordinator checks it and registers you.

errors.limit: No more emails can go to your parent for now (the limit is reached). Try again tomorrow, or come to the class desk with your parent.
errors.alreadyConsented: Your parent has already given consent.

card.mailFailed: The email to {{email}} could not be sent. Check the address, then send it again.

card.changeIntro: Correct your parent's details: a new email goes to them.
card.needsParent: Your parent's consent comes first. Give their details and we email them a code.
card.consentedBody: Come to your first class with your parent's ID (for example Aadhaar), or with your parent. A coordinator checks it and registers you; then your home opens here by itself.
card.expires: If your parent has not consented by {{date}}, this sign-up is deleted with everything in it; you can then sign up again.

parentConsent.title: Consent for your child
parentConsent.intro: Your child signed up for the Mridanga Seva class and gave your email. A child under 18 can join only with a parent's or guardian's consent (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023).

summary.what: What is kept: your child's name, date of birth, gender, mobile number, email and centre; attendance and learning progress; your name, relation, mobile number and email.
summary.why: Why: only to run the class and keep children safe. Never sold, never used for advertising.
summary.who: Who sees it: the class's facilitator and coordinators; your child sees their own record.
summary.where: Where: the app's database is in Sydney, Australia; the emails go through Brevo (European Union).
summary.keep: How long: while your child is in the class. If you do not consent within 30 days, your child's sign-up and your details are deleted.
summary.rights: Your rights: see, correct or delete the data, or withdraw consent at any time, at the class desk or by writing to the class; and complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

parentConsent.emailHint: The address our email with the code went to.
parentConsent.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits of the code.
parentConsent.parentOk: I am this child's parent or legal guardian, and I am 18 or over.
parentConsent.dataOk: I agree that the class keeps and uses my child's details as described above and in the privacy notice.
parentConsent.photoOk: I also agree that the class may take and keep photos of my child (optional).
parentConsent.photoHint: You can change your mind about photos, or withdraw consent, at any time at the class desk.
parentConsent.declarationRequired: Please tick this box to give consent.
parentConsent.notYou: If you do not know about this sign-up, or do not agree, close this page: nothing more happens without your consent.
parentConsent.wrong: The email or the code is not right. Check both against our email. After 5 wrong tries the code stops working.
parentConsent.tooMany: This code had too many wrong tries and no longer works. Ask your child to send a new email from the app.
parentConsent.expired: This code has expired. Ask your child to send a new email from the app.
parentConsent.closed: This sign-up is no longer waiting for consent. Please ask at the class desk.
parentConsent.childSignedIn: Your child is signed in to the app in this browser. Please open the link on your own phone or computer, or sign out here first.
parentConsent.notAvailable: Consent by email is not available yet. Please come to the class desk with your child.
parentConsent.doneTitle: Thank you, your consent is recorded
parentConsent.donePhotoNo: You did not agree to photos: none will be kept.
parentConsent.doneDesk: At the first class, please send your ID with your child, or come yourself (for example Aadhaar): a coordinator checks your name and that you are 18 or over before registering your child. Only the kind of ID is noted, never its number.
parentConsent.doneWithdraw: You can withdraw consent at any time, at the class desk or by writing to the class.

dataRights.title: My data and rights
dataRights.profileHint: What the class keeps about you, a copy to download, and how to ask for a correction, erasure or withdrawal.
dataRights.intro: Here is what Mridanga Seva keeps about you and who handles it for us. You can download a copy, and ask us to correct or erase your data, withdraw a consent, name someone to act for you, or make a complaint. We answer every request within 30 days.
dataRights.notSetUp: Data requests are not switched on yet. Please write to privacy@mridangaseva.com or speak to a coordinator at the desk.
dataRights.printOnWeb: To print it, open the app in a web browser (app.mridangaseva.com) and use "Print or save as PDF".
dataRights.exportFailed: The copy could not be made. Please try again.
dataRights.processorsHint: These services handle data for the class, only on our instructions. Nothing is sold or used for advertising.
dataRights.pageIntro: This is what the class keeps about you. Keep this copy safe: it holds your personal details.
dataRights.minorTitle: Your parent or guardian asks for you
dataRights.minorBody: Because you are under 18, your parent or guardian makes requests about your data: at the class desk (they show their ID), or by email to {{email}} from the address the class has for them. You can still read your data here.
dataRights.guruHint: You answer the class's data requests on Data requests. For a request about your own data, write to the privacy contact.
dataRights.askHint: Choose what you want. We answer within {{days}} days and you see the answer here.

kinds.nominate: Name someone to act for me

what.access: A copy of what we keep, and with whom it was shared, beyond this summary.
what.correction: Tell us which detail is wrong and what it should be. We may ask you to show a document at the desk.
what.erasure: Everything the class keeps about you is erased: your record, visits, progress, practice, recordings and your sign-in. Only your roll number, the date and the reason stay, as proof that we did it. This cannot be undone.
what.withdraw_photo: No photo of you will be kept on the class record or taken for it. Everything else stays as it is.
what.withdraw_data: Your record is frozen: no more check-ins, progress, practice or messages, and your sign-in stops working. What was done before stays lawful. 30 days later the record is erased, unless you consent again at the desk before then. To have it erased sooner, ask for an erasure.
what.grievance: Tell us what went wrong. The privacy contact answers within 30 days. If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
what.nominate: Name a person who may use these rights for you if you die or cannot act yourself (DPDP Act section 14): their name, how they are related to you and their phone number.

dataRights.fieldHint: For example: date of birth, name, phone

bodyLabel.correction: What is wrong, and what should it be?
bodyLabel.nominate: Who, how related, and their phone

dataRights.contactLine: Privacy contact and grievance officer: {{name}}, {{email}}, phone {{phone}}.
dataRights.replyLine: We answer every request within {{days}} days.
dataRights.boardLine: If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

noticeCard.title: Our privacy notice has changed
noticeCard.acceptBody: Version {{version}} of the privacy notice says what the app keeps about you, why, who handles it, how long it is kept, and how to see, correct or delete it. Please read it and say whether you agree.
noticeCard.adultTitle: You are 18 now: your own consent

dataRequests.title: Data requests
dataRequests.intro: Requests about a person's data: corrections, erasures, withdrawals, complaints, nominees. Answer each within 30 days. Withdrawals and erasures are carried out here after you type the roll number.
dataRequests.recordHint: One made at the desk or by email. For a student under 18 only a parent or guardian may ask.
dataRequests.whoHint: For example MS-2026-0030, or the email of a sign-up without a record
dataRequests.whoRequired: Type a roll number or an email.
dataRequests.parentIdHint: At the desk, see the parent's or guardian's ID first (Rule 10). By email, it must come from the address the class has for them. Note what you checked below.
dataRequests.bodyLabel: What was asked, and what you checked
dataRequests.notFound: This request is not there any more (a closed request is deleted after two years).
dataRequests.minorNote: This record is a child's: only a parent or guardian may ask. Check who asked before you act.
dataRequests.textGone: The text was blanked (erasure, or a year after closing).

withdraw_photo.title: Withdraw the photo consent
withdraw_photo.what: The current photo consents of this record are withdrawn. The record and the data consent stay.

withdraw_consent.title: Withdraw the consent
withdraw_consent.what: The record is frozen (no check-ins, ticks, practice or messages), every consent is withdrawn, an open visit and calls are closed, and the sign-in is switched off. Tell the person the answer by phone or email: they can no longer open the app.
withdraw_consent.button: Withdraw consent and freeze the record

erase.title: Erase
erase.what: The record, its history and the sign-in are deleted, and the audit log copies blanked. Only the roll number, the date, your note and this request's reference stay. This cannot be undone. Take back any lent instrument first.

dataRequests.noteLabel: Note to the person and for the record
dataRequests.noteHint: For example: Asked in the app; identity checked at the desk.
dataRequests.answerHint: The person sees this answer in the app (a request made in the app also gets a notice).
dataRequests.markDone: Mark done and send the answer

play.title: Play and learn
play.intro: Games for your ear and your timing, away from the drum too. They work offline; your bests stay on this phone and no one else sees them.
play.soundComing: Drum sound: synthesised. Real khol strokes come once the Guru has recorded them.
play.padHint: Tap it with each stroke of this hand.
play.starsAfterRound: Stars come after each round of answers.
play.best: Your best on this phone: {{stars}} at {{bpm}} beats a minute
play.noBest: No best yet on this phone.
play.tuneNow: Tap either pad with each click: {{clicks}} clicks, after one bar to get ready.
play.tuned: Tuned to this phone. Tune again if the grades feel wrong.
play.notTuned: Phones sound a little late. Tune once, so the grading is fair on this phone.
play.tuneDone: Tuned: this phone’s delay is {{ms}} ms.
play.tuneUneven: The taps were uneven, so nothing was changed. Try again, tapping with each click.

tapPad.title: Tap pad
tapPad.intro: The taal plays. Tap the left pad with each baya stroke (left hand) and the right pad with each dayan stroke (right hand); both pads together for dhā.
tapPad.modeBeat: Only the beat: your taps play the strokes
tapPad.guide: Light the pad and show the bol for each stroke
tapPad.grading: A tap within 70 ms of its stroke is on time, within 160 ms a little early or late. In a cycle, on time counts 1, close ½, an extra tap takes ¼ off: ★★★ from 85 %, ★★ from 60 %, ★ from 30 %.

whichBol.title: Which bol?
whichBol.intro: Listen, then pick the bol you heard. The bols are those of the taals of your level.
whichBol.compare: Tap a card to hear it and compare.
whichBol.wrong: It was {{bol}}. Listen to both, then go on.
whichBol.noBest: Your best in a row is kept on this phone.
whichBol.tooFew: Fewer than three bols for this level. The facilitator adds taals.

echo.title: Echo me
echo.intro: As in class: the app plays one vibhag of the taal, then it is quiet for as long. Your turn: play it back, on your drum or on the tap pads.
echo.showBols: Show the bols while I answer
echo.recordHint: Answering on your drum? Record yourself below with the sound on, then play it back: you hear each call and your answer after it.

learnMore.title: Learn more
learnMore.intro: Free lessons and pages elsewhere that the Guru trusts. They open in your browser and need the internet.
learnMore.saved: No connection: showing the links saved on this phone.
learnMore.openFailed: The link could not be opened on this phone.
learnMore.noneGuru: Add the first one with Add a link.
learnMore.editorHint: Only free material you trust, fit for children. Students see the title, the note and the site’s name.

errors.link_note_too_long: The note has at most 200 characters.
errors.not_allowed: Only the Guru changes these links.

signInCode.title: Sign-in code
signInCode.intro: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code it shows for Mridanga Seva.
signInCode.signedInAs: Signing in as {{email}}. Not you? Choose Sign out.
signInCode.sixDigits: Type the 6 digits the app shows.
signInCode.wrong: That code is not right, or it changed meanwhile. Type the code the app shows now.
signInCode.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
signInCode.notEnabled: Sign-in codes are not switched on for this app. Tell the Guru.
signInCode.wasReset: Your sign-in code was reset. Sign out, sign in again and set up a new one in My profile.
signInCode.lostBody: A coordinator asks the Guru to reset the code (Set-up → Sign-in codes), then signs in with the password and sets up a new one. The Guru asks another Guru, or the person who looks after the app.

myCode.title: Sign-in code
myCode.profileHint: A code from an authenticator app at every sign-in, so a stolen password is not enough.
myCode.intro: A sign-in code keeps children's and parents' details safe: after your password the app asks for the 6 digits your authenticator app shows (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or similar). Install one from the app store first.
myCode.guruAsks: The Guru asks every staff member for a sign-in code: parents' details, consents, call notes and the change history need it.
myCode.isOnNow: Your sign-in code is on. Every sign-in will ask for it.
myCode.missing: Sign-in codes are not set up on the server yet.
myCode.setupHint: Two steps: add Mridanga Seva to your authenticator app, then type one code from it.
myCode.stepOne: 1. In your authenticator app on your phone, add an account and scan this QR code, or type the key below.
myCode.stepOnePhone: 1. Tap the button to add Mridanga Seva to your authenticator app on this phone. Or scan the QR code with the app on another phone, or type the key below.
myCode.noApp: No authenticator app opened. Install one, or type the key below into it.
myCode.qrLabel: QR code to add Mridanga Seva to an authenticator app
myCode.stepTwo: 2. Type the 6-digit code the app now shows for Mridanga Seva.
myCode.onHint: New phone? Set it up again: the old code stops once the new one works.
myCode.offHint: Takes two minutes. You need your phone at every sign-in afterwards.
myCode.newPhone: Set up on a new phone
myCode.confirmOff: Tap again to turn it off
myCode.cannotTurnOff: While the Guru asks for codes, yours stays on. For a new phone, set it up again.
myCode.hiddenTitle: Private details need your sign-in code
myCode.hiddenBody: The Guru asks for a sign-in code before parents' details, consents, call notes and the change history show. Set up yours (or sign in again with it); everything else works as before.
myCode.contactHidden: Parent's phone and email: shown after your sign-in code

staffCodes.title: Sign-in codes
staffCodes.intro: Who has set up a sign-in code. Once everyone has, switch codes on: parents' details, consents, call notes and the change history then need a sign-in that gave the code.
staffCodes.switchHint: Can be switched on only when every Guru and coordinator below has a code, and you signed in with yours.
staffCodes.isOn: On: private details need the code
staffCodes.thisSession: This sign-in did not give your code. Set up yours, then sign out and in again.
staffCodes.confirmOn: Tap again to ask for codes
staffCodes.nowOff: Codes are no longer asked for.
staffCodes.listHint: Reset a code when someone lost or changed their phone; they set up a new one at their next sign-in.
staffCodes.confirmReset: Tap Reset again to remove the sign-in code of {{name}}
staffCodes.resetDone: The sign-in code of {{name}} was removed. They set up a new one in My profile.
staffCodes.giveYourCode: Sign in with your own sign-in code first (sign out and in again).
staffCodes.notEveryone: Not everyone has a sign-in code yet. Ask those marked "No code yet" to set one up in My profile.
staffCodes.resetInDashboard: The app may not remove codes on this server. The person who looks after the app removes it in Supabase (Authentication → Users).

appErrors.title: App errors
appErrors.intro: What broke in the app on phones and on the web, newest first, kept 30 days. The log never says who it happened to: only the error, the screen, the app version and staff or student. Tell the person who looks after the app about anything that repeats.
appErrors.missing: The error log is not set up on the server yet.
appErrors.none: No errors in the last 30 days.
